2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the main accused Susheel Kumar has already been granted anticipatory bail.

He would submit that during investigation notices under Section 41-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 have been given to the applicant; charge-sheet has now been filed and summons have been issued.

4. Let State file objections within four weeks.
5.

6. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witnesses in the case.
(ii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iii) He shall deposit his passport with the court.

opennyai_summary.decision:
He would submit that during investigation notices under Section 41-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 have been given to the applicant; charge-sheet has now been filed and summons have been issued.
4. Let State file objections within four weeks.
5.
List on 23.08.2024.
6. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witnesses in the case.
(ii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iii) He shall deposit his passport with the court.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
If the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the court concerned.
(iv) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i) & (ii) above.
